findings.highlight: Sweat pouring out just by standing outside during the day, and discomfort no matter how many times I turn over in bed during the night.
findings.evidenceJa: 容赦なく体力を奪っていく
findings.explanation: The merciless daytime heat and sleepless nights are explicitly draining Setsuna's physical strength. Todokanai TL translates two atmospheric fragments but omits the main predicate, which sets up her question about what else has been taken from her.
findings.japanese:
外にいるだけで汗が噴き出す日中が、
何度寝返りを打っても寝苦しい夜中が、
容赦なく体力を奪っていく。
findings.todokanai: Sweat pouring out just by standing outside during the day, and discomfort no matter how many times I turn over in bed during the night.

findings.highlight: The train on Line 1 toward Onjuku will depart shortly.
findings.evidenceJa: まもなく、一番線御宿行きが参ります
findings.explanation: The announcement says the Onjuku-bound train will arrive shortly. Todokanai TL says it is about to depart, reversing the train's movement before the later announcement that it actually leaves without Setsuna.
findings.japanese:
「まもなく、一番線御宿行きが参ります。
白線の内側までお下がりください」
findings.todokanai: "The train on Line 1 toward Onjuku will depart shortly. Please stay within the white lines."

findings.highlight: my family didn't allow me to visit him on Friday
findings.evidenceJa: 金曜にお泊まりっていうのは家族が許してくれなかった
findings.explanation: Setsuna's family refused to let her stay overnight on Friday after she spent Thursday ill in bed. Todokanai TL reduces the restriction to visiting at all, changing both the degree of family control and why Saturday morning is only half a day late.
findings.japanese:
さすがに木曜に体調不良で休んでおいて、
金曜にお泊まりっていうのは家族が許してくれなかった。
findings.todokanai: Unsurprisingly, my family didn't allow me to visit him on Fridayーnot after having spent the entirety of Thursday bedridden.

findings.highlight: Yeah, the day will go something like that.
findings.evidenceJa: 今週は少しの時間しか一緒にいられないけど、来週を乗り切れば、今度はお盆休みが待っている
findings.explanation: Setsuna can spend only a short time with Haruki this week, but if she gets through the next one, the Obon holiday awaits. Todokanai TL omits both sentences, deleting the longer reward she uses to propel herself onward.
findings.japanese:
うん、そんな感じ。
今週は少しの時間しか一緒にいられないけど、
来週を乗り切れば、今度はお盆休みが待っている。
findings.todokanai: Yeah, the day will go something like that.

findings.highlight: I can't even board the train
findings.evidenceJa: 全身の汗に熱を奪われ寒気に震えるわたしは
findings.explanation: Sweat is drawing heat from Setsuna's whole body and leaving her shivering with chills when she cannot board. Todokanai TL retains only the failed action and omits the alarming physical state that disproves her heat-exhaustion explanation.
findings.japanese:
なのに今、全身の汗に熱を奪われ寒気に震えるわたしは、
たった一駅先で降りるはずの電車にすら乗れなかった。
findings.todokanai: But right now, I can't even board the train that I'll be getting off a single station later.

findings.highlight: gazing at his ever so slightly changing expressions.
findings.evidenceJa: そんなふうに彼の隣で、彼の回復を見守る
findings.explanation: The sequence culminates in Setsuna remaining beside Haruki and watching over his recovery. Todokanai TL drops that action and leaves the sentence open, weakening the precise caretaking identity she immediately questions as ego.
findings.japanese:
彼の寝顔を見て、彼の数少ない言葉を刻んで、
彼のほんの少しだけ変わる表情を見つめて、
そんなふうに彼の隣で、彼の回復を見守る。
findings.todokanai: Seeing his sleeping face, engraving the few words he mutters in my heart, gazing at his ever so slightly changing expressions.

findings.highlight: the angel of death
findings.evidenceJa: こんな疫病神が毎週現れたんじゃ
findings.explanation: Setsuna calls herself a 疫病神, a jinx or god of misfortune whose weekly appearance prevents recovery. 'Angel of death' makes her an agent or omen of literal death, substantially intensifying and changing the self-accusation.
findings.japanese:
そっか…
こんな疫病神が毎週現れたんじゃ、
よくなるわけなんかないよね…？
findings.todokanai: I get it now… How could he possibly get better when he's visited by the angel of death every week?

findings.highlight: Let's go with a light lunch and a filling dinner then, okay?
findings.evidenceJa: 豚肉安かったから多めに買ってきたんだ
findings.explanation: Setsuna adds that pork was cheap, so she bought extra. Todokanai TL omits the line's final clause, removing the ingredient setup for her cold-shabu idea two lines later.
findings.japanese:
「なんでもいいってのが一番張り合いないんだよね～。
ま、いっか。じゃあお昼はあっさりで夜はがっつりね。
豚肉安かったから多めに買ってきたんだ」
findings.todokanai: "I won't be as motivated if you're fine either way. Well, whatever. Let's go with a light lunch and a filling dinner then, okay?

findings.highlight: let's add it to the noodles cold
findings.evidenceJa: お昼、冷しゃぶもつけようかな
findings.explanation: Setsuna considers adding cold shabu-shabu as another lunch dish. Todokanai TL instead puts cold pork into the somen noodles, inventing a different preparation.
findings.japanese:
「そうだ、せっかく豚肉あるんだから、
お昼、冷しゃぶもつけようかな…
うん、それいいかも！」
findings.todokanai: "Oh, right! Since we already have pork, let's add it to the noodles cold… Yeah, that sounds great!"

findings.highlight: Then I prepared dinner while Haruki-kun was taking a bath.
findings.evidenceJa: そして、夕食が済んだら当然後片付け
findings.explanation: After laundry, room cleaning, bath cleaning, his bath, and dinner preparation, Setsuna naturally cleans up after the meal. Todokanai TL omits the final chore, weakening the intentionally exhaustive account of her keeping herself in motion.
findings.japanese:
洗濯と部屋の掃除が終わったら、お風呂の掃除。
春希くんに入浴してもらってる間に夕食の仕度。
そして、夕食が済んだら当然後片付け。
findings.todokanai: Once the laundry and the cleaning was done, I started cleaning the bathroom. Then I prepared dinner while Haruki-kun was taking a bath.

findings.highlight: in the end there'd be nowhere left to run away to.
findings.evidenceJa: 命ごと壊れてたかもしれない
findings.explanation: Haruki says that without Setsuna he might ultimately have broken not only psychologically but in his very life. Todokanai TL drops that climactic consequence and leaves the quotation open.
findings.japanese:
「もし、雪菜がいなかったらさ…
俺は、何もかもから逃げて、結局、逃げ場を失って、
命ごと壊れてたかもしれない」
findings.todokanai: "If you weren't there for me, Setsuna… I would've ran away from everything, and in the end there'd be nowhere left to run away to.

findings.highlight: I did it, I did it, I did it!
findings.evidenceJa: 報われた、報われた、報われた！
findings.explanation: Setsuna repeats that she has been rewarded three times, receiving Haruki's gratitude as recompense for her suffering. 'I did it' recasts the moment as her own achievement and changes the passively received validation that makes the reversal so brutal.
findings.japanese: 報われた、報われた、報われた！
findings.todokanai: I did it, I did it, I did it!

findings.highlight: "The truth is, I wanted to send you home the moment you arrived here."
findings.evidenceJa:
「本当は、雪菜が来たとき、
すぐに帰ってもらうはずだった」
findings.explanation: Haruki was supposed to send Setsuna home immediately but says he wanted to — The later confession of reluctance supplies the difference between intention and obligation, and the immediate plan is still clear.
findings.japanese:
「本当は、雪菜が来たとき、
すぐに帰ってもらうはずだった」
findings.todokanai: "The truth is, I wanted to send you home the moment you arrived here."

findings.highlight: But I kept quiet about it until now.
findings.evidenceJa: それでも、雪菜を帰すのが今まで嫌で黙ってた
findings.explanation: Haruki kept silent because until now he could not bear to send Setsuna home. Todokanai TL omits his reluctance, leaving cowardice without the attachment that made him postpone the necessary separation.
findings.japanese:
「それでも、雪菜を帰すのが今まで嫌で黙ってた。
勇気のない、意気地のない俺でごめんな」
findings.todokanai: "But I kept quiet about it until now. I'm sorry for being such a spineless coward."

findings.highlight: he's just going to cast me aside?
findings.evidenceJa: 自分が良くなってきたら、わたしは用済みなの？
findings.explanation: Setsuna wonders whether Haruki's improvement means she has outlived her usefulness. Todokanai TL turns that fear of being no longer needed into an accusation that he is actively discarding her.
findings.japanese: 自分が良くなってきたら、わたしは用済みなの？
findings.todokanai: Now that he's gotten better, he's just going to cast me aside?

findings.highlight: What is it about me you don't like!?
findings.evidenceJa: わたしの、何がいけないの！？
findings.explanation: Setsuna asks what about her is wrong or at fault. Todokanai TL changes moral or behavioral failure into something Haruki simply dislikes, shifting the question from correction to personal preference.
findings.japanese:
「どうして？　どうしてなの…？
わたしの、何がいけないの！？」
findings.todokanai: "Why? Why would you…? What is it about me you don't like!?"

findings.highlight: It's not just my forehead he's touching, but the pouring sweat as well…
findings.evidenceJa: 本当に触れたのは、額じゃなくて、そこから噴き出す、大量の汗
findings.explanation: Setsuna corrects herself: what Haruki truly touched was not her forehead but the mass of sweat pouring from it. Todokanai TL makes the sweat an additional object, flattening the correction that reveals what he diagnosed at a glance.
findings.japanese:
本当に触れたのは、額じゃなくて、
そこから噴き出す、大量の汗…
findings.todokanai: It's not just my forehead he's touching, but the pouring sweat as well…

findings.highlight: It's getting harder for you to wake up in the mornings, isn't it?
findings.evidenceJa: それで、昨日も来れなかったし、今日も遅くなったんじゃないか？
findings.explanation: Haruki connects her worsening mornings to her failure to come yesterday and her late arrival today. Todokanai TL omits both concrete observations and leaves his diagnosis open.
findings.japanese:
「朝、起きるのが辛くなってるだろ？
それで、昨日も来れなかったし、
今日も遅くなったんじゃないか？」
findings.todokanai: "It's getting harder for you to wake up in the mornings, isn't it?

findings.highlight: everything I knew he would say
findings.evidenceJa: その思い込みでしかなかった確信は、一字一句違わず、わたしの耳に正しく刻み込まれた
findings.explanation: Her 'certainty' had until then been nothing more than an assumption; Haruki's exact words now confirm it. Todokanai TL says she simply knew what he would say, deleting the crucial movement from fearful supposition to word-for-word confirmation.
findings.japanese:
そして、その思い込みでしかなかった確信は、
一字一句違わず、わたしの耳に正しく刻み込まれた。
findings.todokanai: And everything I knew he would say, he engraved in my mind word for word.

findings.highlight: I ended up making a mess of it all.
findings.evidenceJa: わたしが、冷水を浴びせてしまったからだ
findings.explanation: Setsuna believes she poured cold water over Haruki's improving state, a concrete idiom/image of abruptly extinguishing it. Todokanai TL replaces the action with a generic mess and loses the causal force of her self-blame.
findings.japanese:
わたしが、冷水を浴びせてしまったからだ。
全部、わたしのせいなんだ。
findings.todokanai: I ended up making a mess of it all. This is all my fault.

findings.highlight: whatever courage remains in his broken self
findings.evidenceJa: 壊れかけの勇気を振り絞って
findings.explanation: Haruki wrings out courage that is itself on the verge of breaking. Todokanai TL says his self is already broken and the courage merely remains, changing the object and stage of collapse at the decision to separate them.
findings.japanese:
壊れかけの勇気を振り絞って、
春希くんは…わたしを切り離す。
findings.todokanai: Mustering up whatever courage remains in his broken self, Haruki-kun… cuts me away from him.

findings.highlight: without any regard for the fact that he's fallen apart.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分が壊れることも厭わずに
findings.explanation: Haruki chooses to protect Setsuna even if doing so causes him to break. Todokanai TL treats his collapse as an accomplished fact, losing the deliberate future risk he accepts.
findings.japanese:
自分が壊れることも厭わずに、
躊躇なくわたしを護る選択肢を選ぶ。
findings.todokanai: Without hesitation, he's choosing to protect me without any regard for the fact that he's fallen apart.

findings.highlight: Never come back.
findings.evidenceJa: いや………来るな
findings.explanation: After saying she absolutely must not come for a while, Haruki strips the sentence down to 'No… don't come.' Todokanai TL invents 'never,' turning the immediate separation into an explicit permanent ban the Japanese does not state.
findings.japanese: 「いや………来るな」
findings.todokanai: "No… Never come back."

findings.highlight: he was prepared to bring Kazusa down to hell with him.
findings.evidenceJa: かずさとは、堕ちていこうとしたくせに
findings.explanation: Setsuna bitterly notes that Haruki tried to fall together with Kazusa. Todokanai TL makes him the agent who would bring Kazusa down, damaging the contrast between the mutually chosen fall with Kazusa and his unilateral protection of Setsuna.
findings.japanese: かずさとは、堕ちていこうとしたくせに。
findings.todokanai: Even though he was prepared to bring Kazusa down to hell with him.
